title: A pesca do KizuBot ganhou 6 modos
concept: Patch-notes episode on the 23/05/2026 fishing update: a rotary selector clicks through the six real fishing modes one per beat (1/6 → 6/6), drops into 'Pesca no AFK', then the reliability update for minigames and the configurable hook timing.
claims: modos de pesca: padrão, visão direta, água limpa, céu aberto, mesmo andar, agressivo — changelog 23/05/2026
minigames (pesca, cards, cook, music, mastermind) mais confiáveis — changelog 23/05/2026
tempo da fisgada configurável (módulo Fishing: modes, hook timing — 13 módulos configuráveis)

notes: Hook shortened from 'A PESCA DO KIZUBOT GANHOU 6 MODOS.' (7 words) to 'A PESCA GANHOU 6 MODOS.' (5); KizuBot appears in the update chip at 2.0 s. The concept's spinning 'mode wheel' was replaced with a rotary selector switch that steps deliberately through the modes (NEURO forbids roulette/slot-like visuals). 'delay da fisgada humanizado' replaced by 'tempo da fisgada configurável': BRIEF lists hook timing as a Fishing-module setting but does not state that it is humanized. Mode icons are decorative readings of the mode names, not claims about behaviour. Loop bridge returns to the hook frame.
